response.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with NULL rebrate are excluded by the filter. Rows with NULL rebtotal are skipped by SUM. Rows with NULL feerate (but non-null rebrate) give a NULL net rate and are skipped by AVG, so the two aggregates may cover slightly different row sets.
Average net fee rate is the mean of the per-row difference (feerate - rebrate), not the difference of the two averages. These are equal when no feerate is NULL.
